title: 第5章 密林擒灵禽 溪湾伏水蛙第6章 溪湾除影鼬 一毒困佳人
lines: 夜色渐淡，东方泛起一抹清浅晨光，微凉海风拂过沙滩，吹散了夜晚的潮气。火堆只剩暗红炭火，罗止正仍端坐守在李紫云身旁，一夜未眠却不见半分疲惫。
李紫云缓缓睁眼，睫毛轻颤，映入眼帘的便是少年安稳挺拔的身影，心头瞬间暖意涌动。她撑身坐起，睡眼惺忪，轻声开口：
“你真的守了我一整夜吗，一直都没睡？”
罗止正转头看来，眉眼柔和，语气平静安稳：
“习惯了，在外守夜本就不能睡得太沉。你睡得还好吗，有没有被风吹到？”
李紫云脸颊微红，眼底带着浅浅暖意，轻轻点头：
“嗯，有你在，我睡得特别安稳。”
简单收拾好营地，两人将木棍、木弓与五支木箭妥善收好。经过一夜消化，灵蟹与海鲜的灵气已融入四肢百骸，两人都清晰察觉，自身气息稳固在凡级一阶初期巅峰，只差一步便可踏入中期。
罗止正望向远处密林，神色郑重，沉声道：
“海边虽安全，却不宜久留，食物与水源都需要稳定补给。我们往南走，那边草木更盛、水汽更重，应该能找到干净溪流。”
李紫云毫不犹豫点头，眼神满是依赖：
“我都听你的，你去哪里，我就跟到哪里。”
两人并肩步入林间，清晨雾气未散，空气湿润清新，草木清香扑面而来。阳光穿过枝叶，在地面洒下斑驳光点，脚下落叶松软厚实，一路安静平和。
行至临海空坪附近，罗止正忽然抬手示意止步，眼神微凝，气息悄然收紧，压低声音警示：
“别动，前面有动静。”
李紫云立刻屏住呼吸，小手轻抓他衣角，一双清澈眼眸紧张又好奇地望向前方。不远处草丛中，一只浅金羽毛、头顶赤色羽冠的灵禽正低头啄食嫩草。
这便是赤冠灵鸡，凡级一阶初期灵兽。
周身萦绕着微弱风灵气，身形轻巧灵动，对周遭危险气息感知极强，极难被近身偷袭。
两人驻足的刹那，赤冠灵鸡猛地抬头，双目锐利，周身气息一振，脖颈扬起发出尖锐刺耳的啼鸣，声波淡淡散开。
这正是锐鸣示警！
啼鸣未落，它猛地振翅，数枚泛着风灵气的锋利羽刃朝着两人方向急速射去，攻势凌厉。
这正是羽刃散射！
罗止正眼神一沉，立刻拉过李紫云侧身躲避，羽刃擦着两人身侧射入泥土，溅起细碎沙土。不等羽刃攻势散去，赤冠灵鸡再次凝聚风灵气，喙部泛起淡青色光晕，径直朝着近处扑啄而来。
这正是风灵啄击！
罗止正脚步挪移，轻松避开这一击，赤冠灵鸡见攻击落空，深知不敌，当即不再恋战，全力催动体内风灵气，身形化作一道浅金色残影，朝着密林深处疯狂窜逃。
这正是极速遁逃！
罗止正眼神沉稳，从容取下背后木弓，指尖稳稳搭箭。经灵气强化后的感官与臂力远超从前，他拉弓如满月，目光紧紧锁定灵鸡逃窜轨迹，丝毫不乱。
第一箭破空而出，擦着灵鸡身侧射入泥土，精准逼停它的去路。赤冠灵鸡惊啼转身，罗止正第二箭紧随而至。箭矢速度不快，却准得惊人，径直命中灵鸡翅膀。赤冠灵鸡哀啼一声，从半空跌落，挣扎着想要起身，可翅膀受伤，再也无法施展技能逃窜，片刻便没了动静。
整个过程干净利落，不过数息。
此时日头高悬，光线温暖明亮，已是正午。
李紫云眼睛一亮，快步上前，看向罗止正的眼神满是崇拜，惊叹道：
“你也太厉害了吧！几招就拦下它还成功捉住了，有武器真的不一样！”
罗止正弯腰提起赤冠灵鸡，掂量了下分量，嘴角微扬，轻笑道：
“它本就擅长逃窜和远程攻击，近身战力极弱，不难对付。有了这只灵鸡，今天的食物就够了。”
他将灵鸡简单捆好拎在手中，神色淡然继续道：
content_en:
The night is fading, a light morning light appears in the east, and the cool sea breeze blows across the beach, blowing away the night moisture. There was only dark red charcoal fire left in the fire, and Luo Zhizheng was still sitting beside Li Ziyun. He had not slept all night but was not tired at all.
Li Ziyun slowly opened his eyes, his eyelashes trembling slightly, and what came into view was the steady and upright figure of the young man, and his heart instantly felt warm. She sat up, sleepy-eyed, and spoke softly:
"Did you really stay with me all night without sleeping?"
Luo Zhizheng turned his head to look, his eyebrows soft and his tone calm and steady:
"I'm used to it. You shouldn't sleep too deeply when you're staying out at night. Did you sleep well? Did you get blown by the wind?"
Li Ziyun's cheeks were slightly red, with a slight warmth in his eyes, and he nodded gently:
"Well, with you here, I sleep very peacefully."
After simply packing up the camp, the two of them put away the wooden sticks, wooden bows and five wooden arrows. After a night of digestion, the spiritual energy of the spiritual crabs and seafood had been integrated into the limbs and bones. Both of them clearly noticed that their own aura was firmly at the peak of the early stage of the first mortal level, and was only one step away from entering the middle stage.
Luo Zhi was looking at the dense forest in the distance with a solemn expression and said in a deep voice:
"Although the seaside is safe, it is not advisable to stay for a long time. Food and water sources require a stable supply. Let's go south, where the vegetation is thicker and the water vapor is heavier. We should be able to find clean streams."
Li Ziyun nodded without hesitation, his eyes full of dependence:
"I listen to you. Wherever you go, I will follow you."
The two walked into the forest side by side. The morning fog had not dispersed, the air was moist and fresh, and the fragrance of the vegetation hit their faces. The sunlight passes through the branches and leaves, casting mottled light spots on the ground. The fallen leaves are soft and thick under the feet, and the journey is quiet and peaceful.
Walking near Linhaikongping, Luo Zhizheng suddenly raised his hand to signal to stop, his eyes narrowed slightly, his breath quietly tightened, and he lowered his voice to warn:
"Don't move, there is movement ahead."
Li Ziyun immediately held his breath, gently grasped the corner of his clothes with his small hands, and looked forward with a pair of clear eyes nervously and curiously. In the grass not far away, a spiritual bird with light golden feathers and a red crest on its head was lowering its head and pecking at the tender grass.
This is the red-crowned spiritual rooster, an early-stage mortal-level spiritual beast.
There is a faint wind spirit lingering around the body, and the body is light and agile. It has a strong sense of the dangerous atmosphere around it, and it is extremely difficult to be attacked at close range.
The moment the two of them stopped, the red-crowned rooster suddenly raised its head, its eyes were sharp, the breath around its body was lifted, its neck was raised and it screamed sharply, and the sound waves dispersed faintly.
This is Ruiming's warning!
Before its cry ended, it flapped its wings suddenly, and several sharp feather blades filled with wind energy were shot rapidly in the direction of the two of them, with a fierce attack.
This is exactly feather blade scattering!
Luo Zhizheng's eyes darkened, and he immediately pulled Li Ziyun sideways to avoid him. The feather blade rubbed their sides and shot into the soil, splashing up fine sand. Before the Feather Blade offensive dissipated, the red-crowned chicken gathered its wind energy again, its beak glowed with a light blue halo, and pounced straight towards the distance.
This is exactly what Wind Spirit Pecked!
Luo Zhizheng moved his steps and easily avoided the attack. Seeing that the attack failed, the red-crowned chicken immediately stopped fighting and used all his strength to activate the wind aura in his body. His body turned into a light golden shadow and fled madly towards the depths of the jungle.
This is a very fast escape!
Luo Zhizheng's eyes were calm, and he calmly took off the wooden bow from his back, and placed the arrow steadily with his fingertips. His senses and arm strength strengthened by spiritual energy were far greater than before. He drew his bow like a full moon, and his eyes were firmly fixed on the flight path of the spiritual chicken without any confusion.
The first arrow shot out of the air, grazed the chicken's side and shot into the soil, accurately stopping its path. The red-crowned rooster crowed and turned around, and Luo Zhizheng followed closely with his second arrow. The arrow was not very fast, but it was surprisingly accurate, hitting the wings of the spiritual chicken directly. The red-crowned rooster cried mournfully and fell from mid-air. It struggled to get up, but its wings were injured and it could no longer use its skills to escape. There was no movement for a moment.
The whole process is clean and tidy, and it only takes a few breaths.
At this time, the sun was high in the sky, the light was warm and bright, and it was already noon.
Li Ziyun's eyes lit up, he stepped forward quickly, looked at Luo Zhizheng with eyes full of admiration, and exclaimed:
"You are so awesome! You stopped it with just a few moves and successfully caught it. Having a weapon makes a real difference!"
Luo Zhizheng bent down to pick up the red-crowned chicken, weighed it, raised the corners of his mouth slightly, and said with a chuckle:
"It is good at escaping and long-range attacks. It is extremely weak in close combat and is not difficult to deal with. With this spiritual chicken, we will have enough food for today."
He simply tied up the spiritual chicken and carried it in his hand, and continued with an indifferent expression:
